definitions.gloss: entrance and exit; doorway; way in and out
definitions.explanation: An opening or door that serves as both an entrance and an exit. Common in buildings, rooms, parking lots, and other spaces.

examples.japanese: {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}をふさがないでください。
{非常|ひじょう}{出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}はどこですか。
この{建物|たてもの}の{出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}は{一|ひと}つしかないので、{混雑|こんざつ}しやすい。
examples.english: This building has only one entrance/exit, so it tends to get crowded.

notes:
A compound of {出入|でい}り (going in and out) + {口|ぐち} (opening, entrance). Refers to a single point that serves as both entrance and exit, or more generally to any doorway or access point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}をふさぐ: to block the doorway
- {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}{付近|ふきん}: near the entrance/exit
- {非常|ひじょう}{出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}: emergency entrance/exit
- {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}に{立|た}つ: to stand at the doorway

RELATED TERMS:
- {入口|いりぐち}: entrance (entry only)
- {出口|でぐち}: exit (exit only)
- {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}: serves as both entrance and exit
- {通用口|つうようぐち}: service entrance, staff entrance
